items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1978-Fall Transcript
items.q: I spoke to Dick Allen about that and he claimed that he didn't have anything like that.

ctx.x: I spoke to Dick Allen about that and he claimed that he didn't have anything like that. Oh! Dick is crazy! He really is because I asked him, you know, I told him what I was interested in doing. And I also talked about WTOL's jazz and he said there's nothing really out in rhythm and blues. He said it's some jazz of course.

Well, for your information, the Jazz Institute at Rutgers University will send you tapes if you request anything. So anything you might want in the way of jazz, you should write to the Jazz Institute at Rutgers. They'll send you tapes. The archives is, you know, is really doing it backwards.
